title: State of the Feed — Week of August 10–16, 2026
content_html:
The aggregator processed 10,948 articles across seven runs this week, delivering 644 quality articles with an average fetch rate of 1,564 articles per run. News remained the dominant category at 175 articles, followed by ai-tech at 122 articles and wellness at 70 articles. Climate and science content each contributed 60 and 54 articles respectively, while design, local, and homelab categories ranged from 39 to 51 articles. Remaining categories (scifi, outdoors, homestead) together accounted for 29 articles.

Pipeline efficiency performed at 2.18 mean noise-to-signal ratio across 14 runs, indicating moderate filtering overhead. The ratio ranged from 1.36 to 2.79 across individual runs. Seven new feeds were added this week, including Noema Magazine, Solarpunk Magazine, and audio fiction collections. Three existing feeds reported errors: Mother Earth News, Old House Journal, and Kagi Small Web.

Feed discovery identified three high-scoring candidates for potential integration. The Passive House Network ranked highest at 86.6, with passivehouseplus.co.uk appearing twice at 84.7, suggesting strong alignment with existing homelab and design content priorities.
